reviews.title: Way short of expectations
reviews.text: After the $169 cost and a $60 annual subscription I expect more features, options and customization than I could get with a $60 alarm. I can’t pick loop lengths on tracks that are longer than the loop for turn down. There isn’t a way to have my bedtime playlist play if I have turn down on, unless I go get my phone. The reason I bought the hatch was so I could abandon my phone in another room. the only option for white noise is to play all night. So I’m waking up at some point to turn it off. The library doesn’t actually have many options for actual sound bath with singing bowls, 432Hz tracks, binaural beats (granted hatch isn’t stereo), chakra aligned sound, or actual cello. Partnership with insight timer may make both companies work better. So far this is a waste of money. I’m hoping the customizing features return in a future app update because there is a lot of potential for the value to be here. For now it’s created bedtime frustration and disappointment at the price point.

reviews.title: Disappointing Purchase — Not Worth the Hype
reviews.text:
I received the Hatch as a baby shower gift for my son, and unfortunately, I’m extremely disappointed with it. It’s definitely not what I expected, especially considering the price and reputation of the product.

I previously used a Fisher-Price sound machine for my daughter, which is now about seven years old. She still loves it, and honestly, I do too! Unfortunately, that particular model is no longer sold, so I wanted to upgrade to something newer for my son. I expected the Hatch to be an improvement, but in my personal experience, it has been a downgrade.

My biggest complaint is the extremely limited sound selection, particularly the Infinity sounds. The sounds are repetitive, often sticking to what feels like a single tone that quickly becomes boring and, eventually, irritating to listen to over and over again.

My old Fisher-Price machine offered a much better listening experience, with multiple soothing sound options, including ocean waves, wind, rain, and other sounds. Even its limited selection of lullabies had more variation, making them much more enjoyable to listen to on repeat.

For a baby sleep machine, I expected more variety and a more soothing, dynamic listening experience. I would love to see the Infinity sounds offer at least three different musical variations that rotate continuously until you decide to turn them off or switch to another sound. That would make a huge difference!

I was initially considering paying for a Hatch subscription to access additio

I understand there’s a premium version, but I purchased this without the need to buy more into it and I certainly won’t, seeing how limited the sound options are for “free” users. I have a HomePod that sits right next to it that plays literally anything without the need to sign up for a “premium” account - I don’t know why I bought this Hatch. reviews.title: Concern About Being Able to Stop My Alarm Through the App
reviews.text:
Hello Hatch Support,

I purchased my Hatch specifically because I wanted an alarm that I could not turn off without physically getting out of bed. That was one of the main reasons I chose Hatch over a regular alarm clock.

I recently realized that I can stop my alarm directly through the app, which completely defeats the purpose of what I bought it for. I intentionally chose this product to help me build better habits and make it harder to stay in bed, and being able to turn the alarm off from my phone undermines that entire purpose.

I am genuinely frustrated that there does not appear to be an option to disable this feature. At the very least, customers should have the ability to choose whether they want to be able to stop their alarms remotely. For people who purchase Hatch specifically to hold themselves accountable to getting out of bed, this is a significant issue.

Is there a way to disable the ability to stop an alarm through the app? If not, are there plans to add this option? I would appreciate a clear answer because this was a major factor in my decision to purchase your product.

Thank you.

reviews.title: It’s -10 instead one star
reviews.text:
I bought a Hatch device to improve my sleep, not to have an app that makes me lose it. The irony is almost unbelievable.

This is hands down one of the most frustrating, poorly designed, and unnecessarily invasive apps I have ever used.

Every single time I open it, instead of simply letting me choose what I want to listen to or customize my sleep experience, I’m bombarded with the same ridiculous questions over and over again. Questions I’ve already answered, yet somehow the app never seems to remember my preferences.

WHY? Why does a sleep app need to turn something so incredibly simple into an exhausting, time-consuming interrogation?

I don’t need an app constantly asking me how I feel, what I want, or walking me through endless unnecessary steps. I JUST WANT TO OPEN IT, SELECT WHAT I LIKE, AND GO TO SLEEP!

The interface is painfully inefficient, intrusive, and completely counterproductive. What should take five seconds turns into an irritating process that actually wakes me up and makes me lose patience.

The entire purpose of Hatch is supposedly to promote relaxation and better sleep. Yet the app accomplishes the exact opposite. It’s almost comical how badly the user experience contradicts the product’s mission.

Whoever designed this app seriously needs to reconsider what people actually want from a sleep device: simplicity, control, speed, and peace. NOT an endless questionnaire disguised as a wellness experience.

I am seriously considering returning my Hatch device

reviews.text: This app is the most frustrating thing ever. The alarm itself is good but it NEVER saves in a timely manner.

reviews.title: So dumb
reviews.text: Honestly I hate this. Such a waste of money. All I wanted was to have a light for my room all day. But it constantly turns off. There isn't even an option to just have the light on when I want. Or if there is, it's so confusing to find. Fix this immediately. This thing sucks

reviews.title: New update is hot garbage
reviews.text: The most recent update is absolutely awful. I can’t find anything, you can’t turn the lights on via the app and change the color or intensity. I literally pay to use this and it’s to the point where I’m about to cancel.

reviews.title: Horrible UI
reviews.text: Genuinely one of the worst apps I have ever used for a product in this price range. Not intuitive to navigate and all of the subscription only items are pushed so scrolling to try and find the 20 lights/sounds you don’t have to pay for is exhausting.

reviews.title: terrible update
reviews.text: this update was actually horrible. it took away so much functionality of the app and makes it harder to use the product. a big part of why I bought this to use the light function that a normal alarm clock doesn’t have. it’s like a little lamp for me and that option does not exist without me adding a random sound and then having to fight my way to add a light to it when I just wanna sit in silence. the routine setup is terrible when trying to explore new options of alarms or routines. please give us the option to go back to the previous set up it was so much better an allowed for us the consumer to use it more freely. it’s like we’re being restricted.

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: Worst app I've ever used for something that costs so much for what it is. Never works. Extremely delayed and glitchy which makes it virtually impossible to use. Have to constantly quit the app and restart for even a chance of it working. Fully updated and everything still the same problems. Will randomly blare with a loud brown or white noise and a bright light, waking up my baby when she was fast asleep. FIX. YOUR. APP.

reviews.title: newest update = less intuitive app
reviews.text:
the new update made it so that it’s no longer possible to use your hatch for light outside of your routine. I often use this feature outside of the routine and it’s frustrating that features are actually being taken away from hatch users. I hope this is fixed soon.

Otherwise, the hatch itself is great. The bedtime cues, sounds, and alarm feature have fostered a much better sleeping schedule and now I no longer have to stress about whether my iPhone’s alarm clock will randomly decide to not work.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work for college students
reviews.text: I have probably wasted over 24 hours trying to get my hatch restore 3 to work. I am a college student and I need an alarm to be able to wake me up in the morning and I was so excited when I saved up to buy my first hatch. after taking a long time to be able to find that MAC address to be able to connect it to my student Wi-Fi in my dorm. My hatch would still not connect to the Wi-Fi and it would only connect to the hotspot on my phone. I went to customer service to try to get this fixed but customer service said that unfortunately I would only be able to connect the hatch to my hotspot on my phone. normally that would be fine, but when it’s connected to the hotspot on my phone, I cannot connect to the Wi-Fi. I told customer support this and they said that unfortunately I wouldn’t be able to have my phone connected to the Wi-Fi anymore while the hatch was connected to my hotspot. I have tried countless times to get it connected to the normal Wi-Fi and I have talked to many different customer support people from hatch and they have consistently been unhelpful. If you are a college student do NOT buy this product. Needless to say i will be returning my hatch and getting an Alexa because every other college student i have talked to with a hatch was forced to make the switch because the hatch cannot connect to the wi-fi or eduroam and will only connect to our phones hotspot. Every student i have talked to got rid of there hatch and switched to Alexa or a different alarm clock so j

reviews.title: 3 years later, still outraged at the failures and failures
reviews.text: Picture this - your kid has a fever, and you wake up at 4 am remembering the alarm is going to turn on at 6 am. You want them to sleep in. You think “great, I have an app for exactly this reason!” and open Hatch to turn off that alarm. NOPE, NO WIFI CONNECTION. Has it been sitting in the same spot for months? Has your WiFi been the EXACT SAME for years? WHY WHY WHY would it be disconnected, and why under the big blue sky would it require PHYSICAL RESET TO RECONNECT?????????? Again, WHY???? So I have to crawl silently through their room, TURN OFF THE DEVICE, wait for a super slow reboot, during which it is silent and the kid starts to wake up. It finally turns back on but wait! It’s reverted to old, deleted presets! So the color/sound combo your kid relys on can’t be found with the physical tap, instead it’s loud, random sounds. SO FUN FOR EVERYONE! and the app STILL does not control the device, so I still can’t change the alarm, but there’s no error message so also no clear reason to fix, at 4 am, holding your breath. So now instead of my sick kid waking at 6, they’re up at 4. So fun! And a scenario that never ever should’ve been built in, approved, or supported by a device with this purpose. GARBAGE. Why have these issues not been fixed, patched, whatever? Shame shame shame continues.

reviews.title: Most painfully slow app I have ever used
reviews.text:
I love the hatch product. It’s great. The app is beautiful.
It is also the slowest app I’ve ever used. And despite the fact that the device is fully connected to you phone via Bluetooth THEY ABSOLUTELY CRIPPLE APP FUNCTIONALITY UNLESS YOURE CONNECTED TO WIFI. Why? I don’t know. Sadism perhaps?
It is so incredibly slow to simply open the app. I kept thinking they’d fix this, yet in the two years we’ve had it, it’s only gotten worse. They’ve added so many features to the app yet done nothing to improve its basic user experience, which is ROTTEN. I am sitting in a hotel trying desperately to connect it to WiFi at 11pm because, for reasons I can’t fathom, they locked the ability to change a routine behind being connected to WiFi…so if I can’t some how get this device to connect to WiFi tonight, I will assuredly be testing this hatch into the sun when it wakes us all at 6:30am despite the fact we’re on vacation.
I have tried connecting it to WiFi 6 times. It keeps failing. It won’t connect to the hotel WiFi because it requires a password, and it won’t connect to my phone WiFi, it simply keeps timing out on a screen that says connecting to WiFi can take up to five minutes.
WHY IN THE YEAR 2026 is it taking five minutes to connect to WiFi?! NOT A SINGLE FEATURE SHOULD BE ADDED TO THE APP UNTIL YOU FIX THE CRITICAL UX ISSUES. It is honestly appalling how crippled this app is despite how wonderful the product is.

reviews.title: Terrible app and customer service
reviews.text: I’d give less than a star if possible. The app is required for the set up of the hatch alarm clock— in order to use the alarm clock it  forces you to sign up for a subscription ( via a webpage outside of the mobile application)  then make it impossible for you to login and cancel the subscription. Customer service is unresponsive and tells you to retry the same process over and over although you cannot change the password without knowing the old one. They then asked me to record a screen share, upload to the cloud and share a link— all to change a password. Which is still left unsolved. I’ll be returning the device and requesting a data deletion which so far they are unable to solve as I cannot login to my app ( nor reset the pw) and apparently that is the only way to address the request. This app should be removed from the store and basic functionality should be in place prior to being reinstalled. Also, when some purchases hardware, if a subscription is required for basic set up this should be very clearly outlined. The most unprofessional and under developed experience in tech in over 10 years.

reviews.title: Constantly crashing
reviews.text:
Getting my toddler hooked on the stories in this app is honestly horrible. The content is great 10/10 but the app crashes constantly and then randomly will start playing in the middle of the night. This app has become the source of nightly meltdowns. And the customer service advice is just to redownload the app- which I now do every night and still it’s 50/50 if the app will work.

Update: after writing my original post, costumer service reached out and sent me a new device. While I’m grateful for the device and the attempt at problem solving, my main issues remain. The new device hasn’t randomly started in the middle of the night but it still disconnects constantly- we’ve stopped using the app all together and just rely on the settings on the device which means my toddler doesn’t get to pick his nightly breathing or dream machine story and has to follow the playlist but I guess it’s teaching him to be flexible… again, content of the stories and breathing exercises are GREAT.. just the tech is awful.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: I don’t often take time to write reviews, but I had to share how annoying it is to spend over 100$ on an alarm clock and then be tricked into having to pay for a subscription on top of it! You don’t “have” to pay for a subscription, however the choices for sounds and wakeup options are SEVERELY limited if you don’t! I am a very deep sleeper and I really struggle with getting up in the morning. I was trying to find something to help me ease into the wake up process, not jolt me out of bed too aggressively, but still be loud enough to get me up on time. Hence buying a super expensive alarm clock. I did the free trial for a week after purchase, then cancelled it after the trial was over to just use the free included options. I was eventually forced to pay for it again due to the lack of good alarm sounds to wake me up. That was the whole point of purchasing this expensive alarm clock! I just feel like this was such a rip off. Even still when I’m paying for the subscription I don’t feel like the options are all that great. You would think there would be tons more, but there really isn’t.  Also, a LARGE majority of them are Trans-centered alarms, which is fine … happy you’re happy to be you and all, but there should still be plenty of options that are NOT trans related as well, if waking up to a drag queen yelling “get it girl” isn’t your thing… and there is NOT! Im not happy with my purchase overall

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: This app and alarm clock product, the Hatch Restore 2, just screams of bait and switch. After spending $200 on an alarm clock, thinking it’s one of the best out there with great features and simple two button operation (rise and rest), come to find out the alarm clock needs a WiFi internet connection to work and an app to download in order to program the clock. The app has several free sounds and light options, but that won’t stop Hatch from displaying all the wonderful other sounds and lights that are locked unless you sign up for a monthly fee. And there’s no option to hide these locked options and Hatch will remind to subscribe EVERY SINGLE TIME YOU OPEN THE APP. What a greedy company. After spending so much on an alarm clock, just make the app, sounds and lights free. Have a premium section to buy additional options à la carte. Also, the options to set for rise and rest are limited. For example, I can’t set a bright red light to dim before my bedtime pink noise comes on. Also, I can’t set pink noise to play all night and auto turn off when the rise light begins. Also, I can’t restart just the rise light if I accidentally turned it off. There’s so many limitations in the app. I wish I never bought this clock.

reviews.title: App needs a major revamp
reviews.text:
Hatch is frustrating. This is an expensive product with an expensive subscription that’s meant to help you relax, but does not do so. The new layout is impossible to utilize. If you want to move or edit your current routine, you have to click on three tiny dots on the far left side, but it just sets the clock off and starts playing that specific part of the routine instead of allowing you to edit it. Major issue & needs to be updated. Idk what the developers were thinking.

Furthermore, there’s a serious lack of quality meditations and programs. The people they host on Hatch know zero to nothing about meditation, relaxation, inner peace, or soothing the nervous system. They pay no attention to the tone or volume of their voice, they introduce themselves and provide a sales pitch at the beginning of every session, and there’s waaaaaay too much wanna-be modern/genz/annoying stuff on there that doesn’t actually relax you, which is the point of paying $200 for a clock and $50+ for a yearly subscription). The only good update they’ve done is to add a lady to the evening routine who does nervous system resets but there’s nothing like that for the morning routine (only a lady named Britt who is too loud, quick, and far from relaxing in my opinion). 

Lastly, I wasn’t able to even connect my hatch device because there was a forward slash in my wifi password. So I had to change my wifi password and reconnect all my home devices, just so my hatch can work.

reviews.title: Pretty disappointed
reviews.text: Starting off I need help waking up, not falling asleep. I’m amazed how great the unwinding and sleep feature are but astounded how horrible the wake up ones are. All I wanted was to have the light wake me up with some brown noise playing during the sunrise feature or slightly before… you can’t! It’s locked behind the sleeping/unwinding feature! How can you focus so much on a sleep schedule you forgot the most important part of an alarm clock, to wake up! Why so limited? I would love to wake up to (good) meditation music too but the few selection for waking up are horrible! Most of the audio options are just plain cringy or bad, with only a handful of good ones ( which I can’t use because it’s locked behind the sleeping option). Lastly the subscription service… just no, as I said most of the audio options are dreadful coming out of your static sounding speakers ( $170 for bad speakers, come on!), I’d rather just buy what I want and avoid any subscriptions ( needless to say I cancelled my free trail right away, which you guys made difficult). The only things I really liked was setting my alarm through the app and that it shines a light in my face ,besides that the app locking me out of features, limiting things I wanted to do AND could do if the app was better designed is madding. Booo!! Big boooo!

reviews.title: A great app that is frustratingly slow
reviews.text:
For the price that I pay for a Hatch+ subscription, I would expect the app to be intuitive and fast. 
However, the app takes forever to load even the simplest things, like changing the routine from one to another. It is infuriating, and often I have to close the app and give it a few minutes to make the waiting time improve slightly (say, from a 5-minute wait to do anything to a 2-minute wait) which makes it a painful process when I want to adjust multiple settings and change up my routines.
The app is very well designed and looks great, and has so much functionality (with Hatch+) to change what ever you want on the Hatch, it is just so let down by how slow it is.
All that being said, the app always connects straight away to my Hatch, and I didn’t have any problems with signing in or setting up.

For the price that I pay, on top of the extortionate price of the device itself, I would expect much better things from this app.

reviews.title: Love the Content But…
reviews.text:
I love all of the variety of wind downs and wake up sounds (they even had holiday themes!). The concept and the alarm clock itself are great. However, it is so difficult to change any of the simplest settings. It takes forever to load anything. Saving a new wake up time, adjusting volume, savings new wind down routines, etc. the app is so unintuitive. You can’t edit nearly anything without starting a new part of your routine or deleting entirely and starting from scratch, which would also take forever to save. Sometimes I want to make sure a part of my routine that hasn’t started yet will have a lower volume and higher brightness or vice versa. Or I want to change the order of certain wind downs without deleting and re-adding. I’ve tried restarting my app and reinstalling but nothing works. For an app that charges a pretty substantial subscription fee, you’re not getting much functionality or bug fixes with your money. 

Unfortunately the functionality, speed, and efficiency of the app is enough to deter me from recommending this otherwise great concept. Please fix this, hatch team. The bugs alone are enough to get me out of my relaxed state and stressed from the app’s shortcomings.

reviews.title: Please fix the app!
reviews.text: I could not hate this app more. I don’t want all the meditations and stuff and yet I have to scroll past them every morning and at night to access the controls. Plus the pop up asking me if I want to turn off the alarm in the morning. I don’t. I want to keep the light on as I get up and get ready in the morning but turn the sound off. But the problem is the sound slider doesn’t work most of the time. The app will show that the volume is turned off yet the device is still playing the sound like nothing changed. Then sometimes I’ve had to scroll past meditations about political stress. At night or first thing in the morning that’s the last thing you want to be reminded of. Please fix the app!!! Put the meditations somewhere you have to scroll to and the main controls should be the first thing that is readily available. This is such basic design. It’s so frustrating. This light is SO expensive for an app that doesn’t even work a lot of the time. UPDATE: the app just won't load now. Restarted my phone and that got it to at least load and say it couldn't find any device. Nothing has changed in my setup. Please fix the app!!! Update: I constantly have problems getting the app to load.
